Name: Rainbow Rain
Author: dunnisimtrouble
Description:
It adds some colour to your rainy days in Stardew Valley, making for some very pretty photo - ops.

This mod makes your rain drops pretty rainbow colours. Not necessary but makes a nice subtle difference. :)
